title: Smart Data Models - CityJSON v2.0 - Road
description: https://www.cityjson.org/schemas/2.0.2/cityobjects.schema.json#Road. A road, as part of the transportation network. Part of the Transportation family of City Objects (subclass of the schema's shared _AbstractTransportationComplex).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Road'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

attributes.description: Property. Open attribute bag (StructuredValue), per the source schema (`"attributes": {"type": "object"}` on every City Object type -- CityJSON does not declare a fixed attribute list per type). Populated here with commonly-used, convention-based attribute names for illustration; not schema-enforced by the source.

geographicalExtent.description: Property. Bounding box of the City Object as [minx, miny, minz, maxx, maxy, maxz], per the source schema's shared _AbstractCityObject.geographicalExtent.

parents.description: Relationship. IDs of the parent City Object(s) in the same dataset, per the source schema's shared _AbstractCityObject.parents.

children.description: Relationship. IDs of the child City Object(s) in the same dataset, per the source schema's shared _AbstractCityObject.children.

geometryLoD0.description: GeoProperty. Dereferenced GeoJSON geometry (MultiLineString, MultiPolygon) for this Road at major Level of Detail 0 (covers source `lod` values "0" and "0.0"-"0.3"), flattened from CityJSON's native shared-vertex-array + boundary-index representation. Optional; present only if the source CityJSON file provides a Geometry entry at this LoD for this object. Surface `semantics`, `material`, and `texture` are not carried into this GeoProperty -- only boundary coordinates.
